articles.title: Where is America's foreign policy heading next? ​| The Global Story
articles.titleZh: 美国的外交政策下一步将走向何方？ |全球故事
articles.summary:
A week on from the Democrats’ victory in the US midterm elections, what might these results mean for the rest of the world? 

What will Trump’s foreign policy look like now he has lost control of congress? 

We take a whistle stop tour of Iran, Israel, Russia and China to look at the reactions to the results and the possible consequences. Will this prompt a shift in relations between the US and its allies?

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

00:41 How the world reacted to the Democrats’ election victory
02:34 What Trump’s election defeat means for the Iran war
06:39 Can Democrats block funding for the Iran war?
08:07 Could Pete Hegseth face impeachment?
10:56 Will the election change US support for Israel?
15:08 Is the US-UKraine relationship with Israel changing permanently?
15:47 What Putin makes of Trump’s weakened position
18:02 What the results mean for Europe’s far right
20:18 Is China benefiting from Trump’s foreign policy?
22:12 Will Trump turn his attention to new foreign policy battles?
23:41 Could Cuba become Trump’s next target?

articles.title: Senior US army officer accused of spying for Russia arrested at Nato base in UK | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 被控为俄罗斯从事间谍活动的美国高级军官在英国北约基地被捕| BBC新闻
articles.summary:
A senior US army officer has been arrested in the UK on suspicion of spying for Russia.

The 41-year-old man was detained on Tuesday. Counter-terrorism police said the soldier had been arrested under national security laws relating to obtaining or disclosing protected information and assisting a foreign intelligence service.

The BBC understands the soldier is based at Imjin Barracks in Gloucestershire, which is headquarters of Nato's Allied Rapid Reaction Corps, a strategic operational base for the alliance.

The director of the FBI director Kash Patel said in a statement: "This important arrest involves allegations of espionage, which is of the utmost concern to the United States and our allies."

He added: "While this investigation is continuing, I want to send a clear message – this FBI has no tolerance for anyone who breaks their oath to the United States and whose actions endanger our national security and that of our partners."

Deputy Assistant Commissioner Vicki Evans, from Counter Terrorism Policing London, described the arrest as "significant".
"The allegations are serious and our investigation is very much ongoing," she said.

The unnamed soldier is currently in custody at a London police station where he can be held without charge for up to 14 days. 

Brig Gen Sean Stinchon, commanding general of US Army Counterintelligence Command, said: "The alleged conduct of a senior soldier, entrusted with sensitive information, is a sobering reminder that insider threats are real and persistent.

Fiona Bruce presents BBC News at Ten reporting by Daniel Sandford.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#BBCNews

articles.readingTextZh:
一名美国高级军官因涉嫌为俄罗斯从事间谍活动而在英国被捕。

这名41岁的男子于周二被拘留。

反恐警察表示，这名士兵是根据与获取或披露受保护信息以及协助外国情报部门有关的国家安全法被捕的。

据英国广播公司了解，这名士兵驻扎在格洛斯特郡的Imjin兵营，该兵营是北约盟军快速反应部队的总部，这是该联盟的战略作战基地。

联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔（ Kash Patel ）在一份声明中说： “这次重要的逮捕涉及间谍指控，这是美国和我们的盟友最关心的问题。”

他补充说： “在调查继续进行的同时，我想发出一个明确的信息–这个联邦调查局不容忍任何违反对美国宣誓的人，他们的行为危及我们和我们的合作伙伴的国家安全。”

副助理

这名未透露姓名的士兵目前被关押在伦敦警察局，在那里他可以免费被关押长达14天。

美国陆军反间谍司令部司令肖恩·斯汀雄准将（ Brig Gen Sean Stinchon ）说： “据称一名受托提供敏感信息的高级士兵的行为令人清醒地提醒我们，内部威胁是真实而持久的。

菲奥娜·布鲁斯（ Fiona Bruce ）介绍了丹尼尔·桑福德（ Daniel Sandford ）

articles.titleZh: “所有选项都摆在桌面上” ： AOC关于特朗普弹劾
articles.summary:
House Republicans narrowly blocked an effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, voting 211-204 to defeat the measure led by Rep. Thomas Massie. While President Donald Trump and GOP leaders rallied enough votes to defeat the push, Democrats warn the fight isn’t over and are promising renewed investigations once they take control of the House.

Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and other key lawmakers discuss why the failed vote won’t derail future impeachment efforts, suggesting the resolution could return before the new Congress convenes in January.

0:00 House sinks Hegseth impeachment effort
1:53 Update on midterm races yet to be called
2:57 GOP picks Jim Jordan as House minority leader
4:12 AOC discusses possibility of further impeachments
6:06 Former Hegseth adviser says he should never have been defense secretary
8:43 Panel weighs next steps on impeachment

Watch 24/7 live news with CNN Headlines: https://bit.ly/4eIvlTr

Stream more on CNN with an All Access subscription: https://cnn.it/4AZMu54

#News #Impeachment #Trump

articles.title: Man who admitted to dismembering wife remains emotionless as guilty verdict is read
articles.titleZh: 承认肢解妻子的男子在宣读有罪判决时仍然没有感情
articles.summary: A jury found Virginia man Naresh Bhatt guilty of first-degree murder Tuesday, rejecting his claim on the stand that his wife died by suicide. In shocking testimony last week, Bhatt said he found her unconscious and when he couldn’t revive her, he panicked and dismembered and disposed of her body. He denied killing his wife, Mamta Kafle Bhatt, whose body has never been found.
articles.summaryZh: 直接播放媒体官方频道发布的新闻视频，保留记者原声、现场声音及原始语速。

articles.readingText:
A jury found Virginia man Naresh Bhatt guilty of first-degree murder Tuesday, rejecting his claim on the stand that his wife died by suicide.

In shocking testimony last week, Bhatt said he found her unconscious and when he couldn’t revive her, he panicked and dismembered and disposed of her body.

He denied killing his wife, Mamta Kafle Bhatt, whose body has never been found.
articles.readingTextZh:
陪审团周二裁定弗吉尼亚州男子纳雷什·巴特（ Naresh Bhatt ）犯有一级谋杀罪，驳回了他关于妻子自杀的立场。

在上周令人震惊的证词中，巴特说他发现她昏迷不醒，当他无法让她苏醒时，他惊慌失措，肢解并处置了她的尸体。

他否认杀害了他的妻子Mamta Kafle Bhatt ，他的尸体从未被发现。
